== Course of events ==

With the group taken prisoner after the Army of Revolt seized Nick Chopper's axe and disarmed the party in the throne room, General Jinjur held them at her mercy. Having found the companions helpless before her, Jinjur threatens to destroy each companion in a gruesome way, and alongside this threat she orders that Tip be returned to old Mombi.

The threat leaves the captives with no immediate means of resistance, and it is this danger that drives them to bar the palace doors afterward and gather for a council of war, bracing for the rebels to return. It also sets the stage for the standoff that follows, in which the Scarecrow challenges Jinjur over the legality of her rule before turning to the trick of the mice hidden in his straw stuffing, a maneuver that finally sends Jinjur and her Army of Revolt fleeing the palace in panic.
